title: Finiteness in Square Classes and Weighted Zero Density of Perfect Cuboids
summary: Let $M(N)$ be the number of similarity classes of positive rational perfect cuboids with ordered edges $a,b,c$, space diagonal $g$, and squarefree invariant $N=\operatorname{sf}(abcg/2)$. We prove that $M(N)$ is finite for every positive squarefree $N$, without any restriction on the rank of the associated congruent-number elliptic curve. More precisely, $M(N)\le C^{1+r_N}$ for an absolute constant $C>1$, where $r_N$ is the rank of $y^2=x^3-N^2x$.
